items.name: Panorama Circuit, The Pines Flora and Fauna Reserve
items.when: Any day (orchids at their best in spring)
items.note: 6.2 km loop through coastal heath to a lookout over Melbourne, the Dandenongs and the bay; spring brings out Rabbit Ears, Greenhood and Spider orchids.

items.name: Dandenong Ranges Botanic Garden circuit
items.note: Easy 3.5 km paved loop at peak rhododendron and azalea season; go early on weekends as parking fills, and note the nearby Olinda VW Track area of the national park is closed for planned-burn prep.

items.name: Masons Falls and Mt Sugarloaf, Kinglake National Park
items.note: Short walk to a waterfall that runs well after winter rain, plus the Mt Sugarloaf summit for city views; the Masons Falls BBQs are closed, so bring a picnic.

items.name: Point Nepean National Park
items.when: Daily, vehicles 6am to 8pm in daylight saving
items.note: Walk or ride the shared track to the Quarantine Station and Fort Nepean for big coastal views; part of the Engine House track is closed after a landslip.

items.name: Lysterfield Park mountain bike trails
items.note: 24 km of trails including the 2006 Commonwealth Games course, with easy green loops too; spring is when the winter mud dries out.

items.name: Red Hill Rail Trail
items.venue: Merricks to Red Hill, Mornington Peninsula
items.note: Short 6.3 km gravel trail; climb up to Red Hill for lunch and enjoy the downhill run back.

items.name: Great Victorian Rail Trail, Mansfield to Merton
items.note: 76 km return ride across Lake Eildon with Mt Buller on the horizon; some other sections remain closed after the bushfires, so check the trail's updates before you go.

items.name: Aziza (Dave Holland, Chris Potter, Lionel Loueke, Eric Harland)
items.note: Four jazz greats reunite for the album's 10th anniversary as a highlight of the Jazz Festival's final weekend.

items.name: Melbourne International Jazz Festival: Prahran Market Pop-Up
items.note: Free jazz, soul and R&B while you wander the market. Note: Dee Dee Bridgewater's Saturday show has been cancelled.

items.name: Men At Work
items.note: The Melbourne-born band behind Down Under and Who Can It Be Now? play a hometown show.

items.name: Iron Maiden with Megadeth
items.note: Run For Your Lives tour celebrating 50 years, with a career-spanning setlist.

items.name: The Sweet: The Final Blitz Tour
items.note: Andy Scott leads the British glam-rock favourites (13 Aussie Top 50 hits) on their Final Blitz tour, with Ted Mulry Gang supporting.

items.name: Bon Jovi: Forever Tour
items.note: First Australian tour in over eight years. Public tickets go on sale Fri 23 Oct at 1pm.

items.name: Bryan Adams: Bare Bones (acoustic, new show)
items.note: Just added: an intimate acoustic show, very different from the arena gigs. Frontier presale Thu 22 Oct 12pm, general sale Fri 23 Oct 1pm.

items.name: Zach Bryan
items.note: Update: general sale opens Fri 23 Oct at 11am, with Vance Joy supporting.

items.name: Eric Church
items.note: The country-rock star's first ever Australian headline show, on sale now.

items.name: Nickelback: Everything Under The Sun
items.note: Big arena-rock singalong, on sale now. There's a Geelong date too.

items.name: Underworld
items.note: Just announced: two sets in one night. Presales from Fri 23 Oct, general sale Tue 27 Oct at 12pm.

items.name: Hasan Minhaj and Ronny Chieng: A Debate to the Death
items.note: Two big US stand-ups trade insults in a mock debate; the closest thing to a Seinfeld-scale night this season.

items.name: An Evening with David Sedaris
items.note: The great American humorist reads new essays and diary entries, then takes questions.

items.name: Matt Mathews: Not What I Ordered
items.note: First Australian tour for the Southern storyteller (18+).

items.name: Robby Hoffman
items.note: Emmy-nominated Hacks star with a Netflix special directed by John Mulaney; on sale now.

items.name: Constellation Cup: Diamonds v Silver Ferns
items.note: Game 4 of the trans-Tasman netball series, the biggest rivalry in the sport.

items.name: Capital.com Australian Open (golf)
items.note: National open at one of Melbourne's famous sandbelt courses.

items.name: Matchroom Boxing: Teremoana v Ahio
items.note: Unbeaten Aussie heavyweight (12 from 12 by knockout) headlines Eddie Hearn's card.

items.name: SE Melbourne Phoenix v Adelaide 36ers
items.note: This weekend. Phoenix's next home games: v Tasmania on Sun 1 Nov and v Cairns on Sun 22 Nov (3pm).

items.name: Melbourne United v Sydney Kings
items.note: This weekend: United's Multicultural Game against one of the past two NBL champions.

items.name: Melbourne United v NZ Breakers (Melbourne Cup Eve)
items.note: United's annual night-before-the-Cup showcase; then Brisbane on Sat 7 Nov.

items.name: Throwdown: Melbourne United v SE Melbourne Phoenix
items.note: The Melbourne derby, the loudest regular-season night in the NBL.

items.name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
items.note: Jason Donovan as McMurphy and Nadine Garner as Nurse Ratched; a Melbourne-only season that's already been extended.

items.name: My Fair Lady (Opera Australia)
items.venue: Ian Potter State Theatre, Arts Centre
items.note: The classic musical in the newly refurbished State Theatre.

items.name: Elf The Musical
items.note: Melbourne premiere of the Christmas favourite; a short season.

items.name: The Shawshank Redemption: Live On Stage
items.note: Stage version of the Stephen King story, tickets on sale now.

items.name: ROME: Empire, Power, People (final weekend)
items.note: Last chance: it closes this Sunday. Over 180 objects from Rome's great museums, all shown here for the first time.

items.name: Making Memoir of a Snail
items.note: Final week for the handmade sets, props and characters from Adam Elliot's claymation film.

items.name: Brassaï: Secret Paris
items.venue: Heide Museum of Modern Art, Bulleen
items.note: Photographs and prints of the intimate world of 1930s Paris; check roadworks near Heide before driving.

items.name: Passage: The Art of Atong Atem
items.note: New free show of the Melbourne artist's work, with free events on opening weekend.

items.name: Pinoy Octoberfest
items.note: This weekend: over 20 Filipino food stalls, BBQ and music, all under cover.

items.name: Le Makete Pasifik Night Market
items.note: Pasifika street food, live music and local makers.

items.name: Coffee Weekend
items.note: Over 40 roasters from Australia and around the world under one roof.

items.name: Stock Up Vintage Market
items.note: Curated independent vintage traders.

items.name: Cachivaches Latin Market
items.note: Over 50 Latin food, drink and art stalls with live music.
